name: particles
title: Particles
blurb: Animated particles that repel from the cursor and drift around.
description: Canvas-based particle system where particles move with velocity and are repelled by pointer movement. Each particle drifts with configurable staticity and easing.
use_when: An interactive background that responds to pointer movement with organic particle motion.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices — particles only respond to mouse movement. High quantity values on low-end devices may impact…
a11y: Canvas overlay with mouse-based interactivity. No touch support or keyboard alternatives.
